sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [C]I saw her in the [Em]rightest way
[G]Looking like Anne Hathaway
[C]Laughing while she [Em]hit her pen
[G]And coughed, and coughed
[C]And then, she came up [Em]to my knees
[G]Begging, baby, would you please?
[C]Do the things you [Em]said you'd do
[G]To me, to me

sections.name: Chorus
lines: [C]Oh, won't you kiss me on the mouth and [Em]love me like a sailor?

[C]And when we're getting dirty, I forget [Em]all that is wrong
[G]I sleep so I can see you 'cause I hate to wait so long
